Available shadshiny icon names

Source: R/icons.R
shad_icon_names.Rd

Available shadshiny icon names

Usage

shad_icon_names()

Value

A character vector of icon names accepted by shad_icon().

See also

Other shadshiny utilities: shad_icon(), shad_icon_raw(), shad_run_example(), shadshiny_deps()

Examples

shad_icon_names()
#>  [1] "chevron-down"        "chevron-up"          "chevron-left"       
#>  [4] "chevron-right"       "chevrons-up-down"    "chevrons-left-right"
#>  [7] "check"               "x"                   "minus"              
#> [10] "plus"                "circle"              "dot"                
#> [13] "search"              "calendar"            "more-horizontal"    
#> [16] "more-vertical"       "mail"                "terminal"

#> [28] "file"                "folder"              "clock"
